description: The Infra-Red Atmospheric Sounder (IRAS) on FY-3B is a 26-channel scanning radiometer observing infrared radiation from 0.69 to 15.5 µm. It retrieves atmospheric vertical profiles of temperature and moisture, surface skin temperature, and total column ozone.
facility_description: FengYun-3B is the second polar-orbiting satellite in China’s FY-3 series (afternoon sun-synchronous orbit), launched in November 2010 and operated by the National Satellite Meteorological Center (NSMC) of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA).
